title: Star End time · 4 of 4 — where staff see the testing time
subtitle: Event page summary line (under the event name), Home’s “Today” card on the testing day, and the printed flyer. Amber = the time today; green = the range.

items.caption: Event page, PC 1280×800. “Tue, Dec 1, 2026 · 6:00 PM at Shrewsbury school · both schools · 21 candidates”
Home “Today” card, PC (preview day set to Dec 1). Title “Fall Star Testing · 6:00 PM”.
Printed flyer (paper, one size; shown at its printed width). “Tuesday, December 1, 2026 · 6:00 PM”.

columns.label: After

items.caption: Event page, PC. “Tue, Dec 1, 2026 · 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM at Shrewsbury school · both schools · 21 candidates”
Event page, phone. Still two lines; the range stays on the first.
Home “Today” card, PC. “Fall Star Testing · 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM”.

columns.note: The Events list rows show only the date (no time), so they don’t change. Private testing lines (“Private star testing · 4:30 PM”) keep one time.

footer: Rulebook decision “A” (approved): Star testing events get an End time as well as a Start time, so parents know when to pick up. Preview screenshots (fake database; the fake Fall Star Testing’s start was set to 6:00 PM in preview for these pictures, its date stays Tue, Dec 1, 2026). The “After” column is drawn over the real page — nothing in the app was changed. An event with no end time saved yet keeps showing only the start time, exactly as “Today”. Private testing times (one time) don’t change.
